name: Branden Jenkins
headline: MAXIO CEO | Office of the CFO & Vertical SaaS | Scaling SaaS Companies and Driving Innovation | AI Leadership & Board Advisor
about:
As a seasoned executive with over two decades of experience in the SaaS industry, I have a proven track record of driving significant growth and operational excellence. 

In my current role as CEO of Maxio, I lead a team dedicated to empowering B2B SaaS companies to achieve efficient growth. Maxio provides a comprehensive financial operations platform designed to address the unique challenges of B2B SaaS businesses, including billing, subscription management, revenue and expense recognition, and SaaS analytics. Our mission is to equip these companies with the tools they need to achieve flexible, sustainable growth in an ever-changing market. 

Previously, as Chief Operating Officer at Medius, I secured a strategic investment from Advent International, positioning the company for future growth. I also led two transformative mergers and acquisitions, acquiring OnPay Solutions and Expensya, and drove the expansion of our go-to-market strategy in North America. In my earlier role as Chief Strategy Officer at Medius, I was responsible for the strategic plan, go-to-market and product strategy, corporate development, and strategic alliances, serving as a key spokesperson for analysts and media. 

Prior to Medius, I served as Vice President of Strategy and General Manager of Global Retail at Oracle NetSuite, contributing to the company's expansion from $250 million to billions in revenue. I also led Retail Anywhere as CEO and Chairman, successfully guiding the company through a decade of innovation and growth, culminating in its acquisition by NetSuite. 

My expertise lies in strategic planning, operational leadership, and fostering cross-functional collaboration to achieve business objectives. I am passionate about leveraging technology to drive business transformation and deliver value to stakeholders.

I am honored to join Rydoo‘s Board of Directors. Rydoo empowers over 3,000 clients across 132 countries with smart, automated expense management solutions.  

I extend my gratitude to Eurazeo and Marlin Equity Partners for their confidence in me. Eurazeo’s recent investment, alongside Marlin’s continued support, positions Rydoo for accelerated growth and category leadership.  

I look forward to contributing to Rydoo’s continued success. Sebastien Marchon has built an incredible company and culture, and I am proud to be part of it.

Founded and led DataPilot.ai, an AI-powered benchmarking platform for financial and operational performance. Developed the platform to deliver actionable insights from standardized metrics, enabling businesses to benchmark against peers for improved clarity and control. While the company didn't fully achieve product-market fit, the experience provided invaluable lessons in fast product development, go-to-market execution, and customer engagement.

As Chief Operating Officer at Medius, I oversaw daily operations, directly managing Sales Support, Customer Success, Marketing, Professional Services, Support, Partnerships, Payments, and IT.
 
- Secured a strategic investment from Advent International, positioning Medius for future growth.
- Lead two transformative M&As, acquiring OnPay Solutions and Expensya.
- Drove the development and expansion of our go-to-market strategy in North America.
- Worked closely with an exceptional team to operationalize key strategic initiatives, delivering customer and shareholder value.

As Chief Strategy Officer at Medius, I own the strategic plan, go-to-market & product strategy, corporate development, and strategic alliances.  I also serve as a key spokesperson for analysts and media. I am a big believer of category design, ecosystem development, and verticalization.  Additional focus includes thoughtful build-buy-partner strategies and our customer engagement model.  

Medius is perfectly positioned to own the category of spend management solutions globally for midsized enterprises, and I am delighted to lead the way as their new Chief Strategy Officer

As Vice President of Strategy for Oracle NetSuite, I am a cross-departmental executive, spanning Sales, Marketing, Service & Product.  I create and execute strategies focused on horizontal categories, generating the most wallet share and user expansion.  Using category design principles, robust analysis, and overall entrepreneurial experience - the War Room is full of Buy/Build/Partner strategies and executive alignment.

experiences.position: Vice President of Strategy, Target Markets
experiences.description:
As VP of Strategy, Target Markets for Oracle NetSuite, I created and executed focused initiatives which drive market share domination, increased customer engagement and overall success for NetSuite & our customers. I did this by developing clear strategies with ROI and organizing cross-functional teams to be fully dedicated to the micro-vertical. Successful initiatives included branded manufactures and digitally native brands in Apparel Footwear & Accessories, Health & Beauty, Food & Beverage, along with Campus Stores, and Restaurants Hospitality markets.

- Complete redesign of go-to-market and customer engagement model
- Reduced customer acquisition and go-live times from months, to weeks
- Significantly lowered implementation times & cost, improving ARR to professional services ratios
- Increased customer life-time-value in initial ARR along with ongoing land & expand strategies
- Lowered customer acquisition costs with referrals, lower discounts, and optimized sales cycles

As General Manager of Global Retail at NetSuite, I led teams through a period of rapid growth from under $25 million in revenue to north of $150 million in revenue in advance of the acquisition by Oracle. 

I was retained post-acquisition of my company, Retail Anywhere, Inc., as GM for Global Retail, serving as the authority over our customer success, strategic partnerships, technology investments, and enhanced product offerings. Throughout my tenure, I have launched and currently chair NetSuite’s Retail Customer Advisory Board and generated a major increase in our brand awareness through continuous collaboration with major media. 

Other achievements include: 
• Spearheaded development of a transformative digital in‐store application, SuiteCommerce In‐Store. 
• Closed major wins with brands such as William‐Sonoma and WHSmith. 
• Successfully guided the vision, negotiations, and due diligence for M&A with Retail Anywhere, Inc.

After taking over as CEO in 2002, I built and empowered a management team focused on attaining market penetration and operationalizing our business structure. I also spearheaded a shift in our business model by launching a SaaS / Cloud solution. This, along with other decisive leadership moments, helped drive year-over-year growth and substantial bottom-line improvement. 

Key Achievements: 
• Earned multiple awards and credentials, including NetSuite New SuiteApp Partner of the Year (2012), 
IBM Market Growth Achievement Award (2007, 2011, 2012) and Inc. 5000 list of America’s Fastest Growing Companies (2007, 2008).
• Guided complete restructure and turnaround to profitability after regular annual EBITA loss.
• Progressed into CEO role after serving as Director of Sales (1998 – 2002)

In another successful turnaround, I was hired by the Founder and Investors to steer the company through a comprehensive restructuring focused on streamlining operations and driving new products. I did so successfully, installing a new management team and a culture of accountability. 

Key Achievements:
